description: Workflow envelope shared between atiproto XRPC endpoints and the agent interpreter. The server emits an outboundWorkflow when it needs the agent to execute repo writes against the user's PDS; the agent runs the actions and calls back with an inboundWorkflow.

create.description: Instructs the agent to call com.atproto.repo.createRecord on the user's PDS.

repo.description: DID of the repo to write to. The PDS auth check is the source of truth for whether the write is allowed.

name.description: Server-assigned name for this action; echoed back on the corresponding response so the server can correlate.

rkey.description: Optional. When omitted (the default), the PDS generates the rkey and returns the resulting URI on the response. Server-assigned rkeys are reserved for fixed-rkey records like com.atiproto.profile/self.

update.description: Instructs the agent to call com.atproto.repo.putRecord on the user's PDS.

delete.description: Instructs the agent to call com.atproto.repo.deleteRecord on the user's PDS.

raise.description: Terminal action: the agent throws a WorkflowRaisedError carrying message and code. Subsequent actions in the same batch are not executed.

response.description: Result of executing one action. Carries the verb (so the server can branch without inspecting result shape) plus the action name and the resulting record reference.

cid.description: Present on create/update responses; absent on delete (the record is gone).

error.description: Populated by the agent when an action fails. The server's error branch uses this to construct compensating actions and a final raise.

action.description: The verb of the action that failed (create/update/delete).

inboundWorkflow.description: Agent → server callback envelope. Echoes the server's intent verbatim, except when the agent overrides to "error" after an action failure.

outboundWorkflow.description: Server → agent envelope. Server-defined intent string acts as a phase marker; the agent treats it as opaque. Each item in `actions` is discriminated by `$type` against `#create` / `#update` / `#delete` / `#raise`.
